name: AVA 数据分析

description_en: Analyze files, databases, inline data and Feishu Bitable, verify metric changes, and produce results and interactive charts.
examples_zh: 分析我上传的 CSV，核对收入变化

核对各产品变化之和，并生成图表
examples_en: Analyze my CSV and verify revenue changes
Connect my database and find the largest product changes
Reconcile product contributions and create a chart
